answer:
A newly created Fighter starts with 4 items, defined in `worker/src/services/character.ts`:

- **`CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS.Fighter = [2, 15, 17, 23]`**, granted via `grantStartingEquipment()` (called from `createCharacter()`), one row per item inserted into `character_inventory`.

Resolving those IDs against `worker/src/db/seed.sql`:

| ID | Item |
|---|---|
| 2 | Longsword |
| 15 | Shield |
| 17 | Potion of Healing |
| 23 | Torchx5 (torches) |

Note: the code comment on that line says `// Longsword, Shield, Potion, Rations`, but item 23 is actually *Torchx5*, not Rations — this is tracked as known bug **B-09** in `../bugs.md`, referenced from `worker/src/services/character.md`.
